USABLE02.query: Can a delayed physical equipment request or receipt fire a replaced, dropped or cancelled tool, and how is the worker queue bounded?
facts: Physical actions share issued-observation identity and additionally carry usable_index, instance_id and equipment_epoch; copied requests and receipts are scoped to run, actor, generation, equipment/body identity and request ID.
Worker admission is atomic for at most eight requests globally and one pending request per actor, counting extracted in-flight work. Explicit refusals do not replace already admitted queued work.

Cancellation is serialized with material consumption; old generations, expired leases, reset epochs and duplicate receipts cannot apply a new transaction or repeat recoil. Already committed projectiles and devices remain until their normal or World lifetime ends.

ACT14.query: How do articulated actors wield, aim, recoil, drop and pick up tools, and are all 32 requested usable illustrations functional items?
facts: ACT-005 carries all 32 U01-U32 usables onto real articulated equipment parts, reusing an existing held part or adding one within the eight-part limit. M or left mouse uses, right mouse alternates, N releases and U picks up a nearby part.

Independent equipment aim steers a bounded physical mount; effects use the actual copied muzzle and per-part native source/target masks. Held, released, fixed, deployed and picked-up equipment retains one body ID; pickup checks bounded proximity and clearance without teleporting or resetting velocity.

Run, actor, generation, equipment epoch, instance, body and request identity fence remote work and receipts. Only a matching accepted consumed receipt permits bounded physical recoil once. Cancellation retires pending intent without deleting committed projectile/device state.

LCB08.query: How do I reconcile exact Water quantity after edits, reactions and normalization without counting transport as creation or mixing cell counts with mass?
facts: The completed-boundary quantity ledger covers stored visible Water plus pressure overfill across the whole World, including body-masked, paused and out-of-interest cells. Normalization is a declared setup-only source/sink; external edits, generated chunks, events, pair products and kernel conversions have separate aggregates.

Conservative FreeMass/PF transfers, relief and whole-tuple movement do not book physical creation or destruction. Pair reactions book gross Water inputs and outputs, including Water-to-Water products, with stable catalogue rule identity; no ordered reaction replay or #160 chemistry change is claimed.

Per-material live/prepared populations use cell units separately from Water quantity. Fixed per-job deltas merge serially; checked external/generated overflow refuses before mutation, and worker/reduction overflow quarantines the World.

CYPS2 and complete physical hash v2 retain the ledger and immutable construction binding. Restore checks roles, closure, prepared-population bounds and actual stored authority; structural consistency does not authenticate every possible external history.
